```html
<div class="container mx-auto p-4">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Note Index</h1>

    @if (session('status'))
        <div class="bg-green-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded mt-2">{{ session('status') }}</div>
    @endif

    <livewire:note-create-button />

    <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
        @foreach ($notes as $note)
            <li class="mb-2">
                <p wire:model="selectedNoteId" value="{{ $note->id }}">{{ $note->title }}</p>
                <button wire:click.prevent="edit({{ $note->id }})">Edit</button>
                <form wire:key="delete-form-{{ $note->id }}" method="POST" action="{{ route('notes.destroy', $note->id) }}">
                    @csrf
                    @method('DELETE')
                    <button type="submit">Delete</button>
                </form>
            </li>
        @endforeach
    </ul>

    <livewire:pagination />
</div>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        Alpine.data('noteIndexComponent', () => ({
            selectedNoteId: null,
            notes: [],
            pagination: {},
            fetchNotes() {
                Livewire.emit('fetch-notes');
            },
            edit(noteId) {
                this.selectedNoteId = noteId;
                Livewire.emit('edit-note', noteId);
            }
        }));
    });
</script>
```
